stories.title: School orchestra cuts penalise young people in rural areas, says principal
stories.summary: More than 2,000 young musicians have been told that transport to take part in bands and orchestras is being withdrawn.

stories.title: School offers prizes to pupils for turning up to class on day GTA 6 comes out
stories.summary: Belfast Boys' Model school issued letters to parents, saying that the release of the game on Thursday coincided with GCSE maths exams.

stories.title: Rail services and discounts are hit in Translink cutbacks
stories.summary: Late-night train services in Northern Ireland are to be reduced and some fare discounts are to be lowered as part of new cost-cutting measures.

stories.title: More than £160m needed to clean up one of Europe's largest illegal dumps
stories.summary: Environment Minister Andrew Muir has described what happened at Mobuoy, near Derry, as an "absolute scandal" which could take a generation to fix.

stories.title: NI only part of UK to see increase in employment
stories.summary: The number of workers on company payrolls in NI in October 1% higher than the same time last year at 822,800.

stories.title: Irish boxer Reeves dies aged 31 after three months in coma
stories.summary: Irish boxer Lee Reeves has died aged 31, three months after he suffered serious injuries in a bout in Dublin, his promoter Queensberry has announced.

stories.title: Nursing union 'dissatisfied' with safe staffing legislation
stories.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler introduced the Health and Social Care (Staffing) bill in the assembly on Monday.

stories.title: Mystery of 2,000-year-old bog body solved in 'first of its kind' investigation
stories.summary: The Ballymacombs More Woman was discovered near Bellaghy - and suffered a deliberate decapitation.

stories.title: 'Weak' vehicle testing contract cost £5m and contributed to MOT delays
stories.summary: A weakly drafted contract meant the Driver and Vehicle Agency took years to get rid of a company which was failing to deliver an upgrade of its vehicle testing centres.

stories.title: Bird flu case confirmed as 'all poultry on site' to be culled
stories.summary: Mandatory disease control measures "including the humane culling of all poultry on the site" will take place.

stories.title: Wilson apologises for not declaring Israel debate interest
stories.summary: The DUP MP said he had "inadvertently failed" to declare that he had visited Israel on a trip funded by its embassy.

stories.title: Sinn Féin 'content' with 1998 bombing campaign, Omagh inquiry told
stories.summary: Retired Chief Superintendent Norman Baxter was giving evidence at an inquiry into the 1998 bombing.
